d: We are seeking a Business Continuity Specialist to develop, implement, maintain, and test Business Continuity Management (BCM) plans and operational resilience frameworks.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Business Continuity Planning (BCP), Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Risk Assessment, and Disaster Recovery (DR), with a strong understanding of regulatory compliance and business continuity standards.

This role will work closely with IT, Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure the continuity of critical business services, minimize operational disruptions, and strengthen organizational resilience.
q: li
Bachelor's degree in Risk management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Cybersecurity , or a related field.
li
Hands-on experience in Business Continuity Management (BCM), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), or Operational Resilience .
li
Practical experience conducting Business Impact Analysis (BIA), Risk Assessments, and Business Continuity Testing .
li
Understanding of Disaster Recovery Planning (DRP), Recovery Time Objectives (RTO), and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) .
li
Familiarity with SAMA regulatory requirements related to business continuity and operational resilience is preferred.
li
Experience in FinTech, banking, payment gateways, financial services, insurance or other regulated industries is an advantage.
li
Strong analytical, problem-solving , documentation, and reporting skills.
li
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills , with the ability to coordinate across technical and business teams.
li
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
r: Business Continuity Management: Develop, implement, review, and maintain Business Continuity Plans (BCP), policies, procedures, and recovery strategies.
Business Impact Analysis (BIA): Conduct Business Impact Assessments to identify critical business processes, dependencies, Recovery Time Objectives (RTO), and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and monitor operational risks and potential disruptions affecting critical business services.
Disaster Recovery Coordination: Collaborate with IT teams to align Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP) with business continuity objectives and recovery requirements.
BCP Testing & Exercises: Plan, coordinate, and document business continuity exercises, tabletop simulations, and recovery testing activities.
Regulatory Compliance: Support compliance with Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) requirements, applicable regulatory frameworks, and internal business continuity policies.
Incident Response & Crisis Management: Support incident response, crisis management, and business recovery activities during operational disruptions.
Monitoring & Reporting: Track business continuity performance, identify gaps, prepare management reports, and recommend corrective actions.
Stakeholder Coordination: Work with cross-functional teams to maintain business continuity readiness and deliver awareness and training activities.
Continuous Improvement: Review testing results, incidents, and audit findings to improve business continuity processes and organizational resilience.

d: As a Sr. Specialist Strategic Accounts & Partnerships - MENA you will work within the regional business team at talabat. This team manages talabat’s enterprise business strategy & manages relationships with the largest regional partners across 8 markets.

We are looking for a sharp, hands-on generalist to support talabat’s regional strategic accounts team with data-driven insights, engaging presentations, and operational efficiency. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in high-pressure environments, simplifying data into clear narratives and can seamlessly manage multiple moving parts across functions. You will be closely involved with portfolio management, heavy analytics, top-down problem-solving, and stakeholder management.
q: li
A graduate in Economics, Business, or Statistics from a reputed institution.
li
4-5 years of experience in performance or program management at an internet-first/consumer-tech company is a must.
li
Extremely high proficiency with Google Sheets and Google Slides for data analysis and executive storytelling (these would be critical to your daily tasks and deliverables).
li
Strong analytical mindset and a passion for simplifying data into clear insights.
li
Strong communication and people skills; ability to influence internal as well as external stakeholders.
li
A structured thinker with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills (including the confidence to push back when needed).
li
Exposure to user engagement funnels and metrics such as iROAS, CM, unit economics, DAU/MAU etc.
li
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect contracts, marketing, performance, and partner experience into one operating model.
r: Analyze large, varied datasets (business, marketing, operational) to extract trends, flag early signals, and generate actionable insights.
Own the development and delivery of quarterly and annual partner reviews, using deep analytics and clear, recommendation-led visual storytelling.
Proactively surface growth opportunities and risks; collaborate with legal and finance to address contract blockers and drive solutions.
Own tracking of partner investments and volumes in line with commercial agreements, ensuring performance is transparent and on target.
Work closely with account managers and marketing teams to drive campaign planning across markets, to deliver measurable impact for vendor partners, especially for high-priority or exclusive vendors.
Assist in resolution of POS and operational issues across functions in a timely, structured way to ensure partner satisfaction.
Improve Vendor NPS by addressing gaps beyond day-to-day KAM interactions and establishing frictionless communication, fast resolutions, and high trust with partners.
Build strong relationships with KAMs and partner stakeholders; travel regularly to drive market-specific planning and execution.
Manage multiple concurrent workstreams across functions (sales, marketing, finance, ops, legal etc) and all talabat markets, while keeping timelines, stakeholders, and partner outcomes on track.

We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
